about_the_game:
Many see only chaos in the frontier peninsula of Briaria, you see opportunity. Guilds of Greybrook is a roguelike management simulator where your choices matter. You choose who to hire, which contracts to take on, and which of the territory's squabbling factions to team up with, if any.

Operate the choppy waters of business management, you've got employees to pay and taxes due so make sure to manage your finances carefully, or perhaps find a sneaky way out of paying either altogether.

The best way to make money is to complete contracts, each requiring you meet a different stat threshold. Using a discerning eye, assign the right members for the job and roll the dice (cross your fingers they don't mess it up, or worse, get injured.)

As the seasons turn though the jobs will keep getting harder, make sure your employees aren't falling behind. Send members on training days, equip them with useful items from the local shops, or maybe just replace them with someone more competent (I'm sure they won't be vindictive about it.)

Dare to put your stamp on the face of history and wishlist Guilds of Greybrook today!
